lanes.name: The Right Moment
lanes.narrative: Turn cited research into a living view of what changed, when to revisit a sponsor, and which opportunity deserves attention now.

lanes.name: From Email to Introduction
lanes.narrative: Carry context beyond approved outreach, from operator-recorded replies to explicit, consented introductions between sponsors and hosts.

lanes.name: A Season, Not a Spreadsheet
lanes.narrative: Move from individual matches to a deliberate event portfolio, then use confirmed outcomes to sharpen the next season's sponsorship choices.

lanes.name: Independent Desks, Shared Opportunity
lanes.narrative: Make Scout safe to demonstrate, useful with independent event sources, and capable of a consent-based network without exposing private prospecting.
